citation: Guidone, R. et al. Uptake of H14CO3-/14CO3 2- by calcite: impact of ISA and chloride. RSC Advances 2025, 15(46), 38762-38773. DOI 10.1039/D5RA05547D. Licence CC BY 3.0.
source_urls_read: Europe PMC supplementary-files endpoint for PMC12525538 (reader 1 only)
readers: reader 1: source-research subagent (PMC HTML + Europe PMC SI); italics read as the modeled row
reader 2: blind web-fetch subagent given no numbers (PMC HTML, verbatim passes); row mapping inferred from caption and text
reader_agreement: all four measured Table 1 values, the 2-sigma convention, T = (22 +/- 2) C under air, S/L 1 g/L, >= 24 h equilibration agree between readers
table: Table 1. Composition of the calcite saturated solution (CSS) under air atmosphere used in this work
uncertainty_convention: two times the standard deviation (2 sigma) of mean values; replicate count NOT STATED

pH.note: Orion Ross electrode, 3.0 M KCl fill, buffers pH 7-10; whether pH_exp or pH_m is NOT STATED

Ca_tot_M.method: ICP-OES (PerkinElmer Optima8300) or ICP-MS (Nexion 2000P); which one for Table 1 NOT STATED

C_tot_M.definition: [HCO3-] + [CO3 2-] per the caption; measured as TIC (Shimadzu TOC-L)

modeled_row_not_used.basis: ThermoChimie v.12a calculation (paper Fig. 7 caption cites pCO2 = -3.5, units unstated)

T_C.pm_convention: NOT STATED (treated as a bound by the preregistration)

conditions.atmosphere: air; air-gloveboxes for active work; pCO2 NOT MEASURED
conditions.solid: CaCO3, Sigma-Aldrich ACS reagent 99.0%, BET ~0.56 m2/g
conditions.equilibration: magnetic stirring 100 rpm, room temperature, at least 24 hours
conditions.separation: centrifugation 6000 g 10 min or 10 kDa ultrafiltration

article_bytes_note: PMC/Europe PMC served bot-challenge pages to non-browser clients, so no stable article bytes could be hashed; this transcription is the frozen dataset and its sha256 is recorded in docs/research/OPERATION_XXV_PREREGISTRATION.md
